intro: Part 2: a headline. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: Check the author, the date, the link to the source and the type of evidence. A quotation reproduces a voice; a headline summarises and may simplify. Distinguish «kilden siger» (the source says) from what the outlet concludes.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

frases.estudio: Overskriften siger, at priserne falder kraftigt.
frases.alumno: The headline says that prices fall considerably.

frases.alumno: In the article, the fall affects only one product group.
